name: Wisconsin

statute.cite: Wis. Admin. Code Trans 305.32 (side and rear windows)
statute.readVia: web.archive.org snapshot 2026-06-11 of the official page (docs.legis.wisconsin.gov refused our connection)

windshield.strip: film only on the part of the windshield both outside the critical area and above the 'AS-1' line marked by the manufacturer; if there is no AS-1 mark, no film on the windshield

frontSide.note: glazing + film combined at least 50%; film inside only, not reflective

backSide.note: glazing + film combined at least 35%; not reflective

rear.note: glazing + film at least 35%, not reflective; if the rear window transmits less than 60%, left and right outside mirrors required

tint.measuredHow: film + glass combined ('combination of the glazing and tinting film')
tint.dualMirrors: Outside rear-view mirrors on left and right required if the rear window transmits less than 60% of visible light

medicalExemption.text: On the recommendation of a physician or Christian Science practitioner treating the owner or an immediate family member, front side windows may go down to 35% (non-reflective). A written statement identifying the patient, condition, whether temporary or permanent, and the vehicle (make, model, year, VIN) must be carried in the vehicle; film removed when the vehicle is sold, the person moves out, or a temporary condition ends.

penalty.text: Not stated in Trans 305.32; penalty provision for violating Trans 305 rules not confirmed

tint.lastAmended: Created Register Feb. 1996, No. 482; amended Oct. 1997, No. 502
quotes: the combination of the glazing and tinting film permits passage through the windows of at least 50% of the visible light striking the windows. Tinting films permitted under this subdivision may not be reflective.
the combination of the glazing and tinting film permits passage through the window of at least 35% of the visible light striking the window
If a rear window does not transmit at least 60% of the visible light striking the window, the vehicle shall be equipped with an outside rearview mirror on the left and right side
When measuring total light transmittance under subs. (4) (b), (5) (b) and (6), law enforcement officers shall allow a tolerance of 3%.
If no such mark was affixed to the windshield by its manufacturer, no window tinting film may be attached to the windshield.

helmet.conditions: Operators and riders under 18 and instructional permit holders; operators may not carry a passenger under 18 without a helmet

handheldPhone.noviceOrAgeBan: Probationary license and instruction permit holders may not use a cell phone while driving except to report an emergency (346.89(4)); no phone use in highway work zones with workers present (346.89(4m))

studdedTires.season: Only authorized emergency vehicles, school buses, mail delivery vehicles and out-of-state automobiles passing through for 30 days or less; dates set by DOT rule (not read)

radarDetector.note: No state ban found; commercial vehicles over 10,001 lb banned federally (49 CFR 392.71)

openQuestions: Official site refused connections; statutes read via Wayback snapshots (2025-2026)
